poly-will-flavio-bolsonaro-win-the-secon.recent: Brazil's first round, held alongside votes for governors and Congress, failed to produce a winner and sent the presidency to a runoff. Bolsonaro's stronger-than-expected showing put the left on the defensive. Nothing reported since that vote explains the contract's later swings.

stocks:KTOS.standing: A San Diego defense contractor that builds jet-powered target drones and low-cost uncrewed combat aircraft, among them the XQ-58A Valkyrie. Its revenue depends on how far the Pentagon commits to cheap, expendable aircraft.
stocks:KTOS.recent: Airbus says its U740, the European variant of the XQ-58A Valkyrie, has flown at Mach 0.8 in Northern Europe. That is a step forward for the drone Kratos designed, and it does not account for the fall in the share.

stocks:SPCX.standing: The rocket and satellite company founded by Elon Musk. It launches most of the world's orbital payloads on reusable Falcon rockets and runs Starlink, the satellite internet network that supplies most of its revenue.
stocks:SPCX.recent: The shares rose on a nationwide low-band spectrum deal for Starlink Mobile, as Verizon and AT&T fell 7%. Since then, Starlink holds a licence in India but still cannot sell service, and Ukraine says its drone links were throttled at speed; Musk blames Washington for the Starshield limits.

stocks:1211.HK.standing: The Shenzhen carmaker that builds only battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles and makes its own batteries. Its price cuts set the pace of China's car market, and its exports draw tariffs abroad.
stocks:1211.HK.recent: BYD said it will own 18 car-carrier ships by 2029, up from 8, because a shortage of vessels and war-driven freight costs, with Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb disrupted, are holding back its exports. Nothing in the reporting accounts for the fall in the shares.

stocks:NOC.standing: A US defence contractor that builds the B-21 stealth bomber, the Sentinel nuclear missile, satellites and rocket motors. Most of its revenue comes from the US government, so its share follows the defence budget.
stocks:NOC.recent: Northrop's Talon Blue, a Collaborative Combat Aircraft, completed its first fully autonomous flight at Mojave on 3 October. Nothing else in the window was about the company's own business, and a first flight does not account for the fall in its share.

stocks:9984.T.standing: A Tokyo-listed holding company run by founder Masayoshi Son that owns most of chip designer Arm and backs technology firms through its Vision Funds. Its share moves with what investors will pay for AI.

stocks:005930.KS.standing: South Korea's largest company and the world's biggest maker of memory chips, alongside phones and displays. It is the heaviest weight in Seoul's benchmark index, so its share moves the whole market.
stocks:005930.KS.recent: Samsung forecast a record 107.4 trillion won profit, a 780% jump in quarterly operating profit on the AI boom, and the share fell anyway. The selloff in Seoul turned on questions over AI spending and Chinese memory rivals, and with SK Hynix it dragged South Korea's benchmark index down 5.5%.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest chipmaker, making the DRAM and NAND memory inside servers, phones and PCs. It is a leading supplier of the high-bandwidth memory stacked beside AI processors, so its share follows data-centre spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: Samsung and SK Hynix dragged South Korea's benchmark stock index down 5.5% in a single session. The selling turned on two pressures on the memory makers: AI spending, the demand behind their most profitable chips, and competition from Chinese memory rivals.

stocks:BHP.standing: An Australian miner, one of the world's largest, based in Melbourne. It digs iron ore in Western Australia and copper in Chile, so its share moves with Chinese steel demand and the copper price.

poly-2026-balance-of-power-d-senate-d-ho.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats win both the Senate and the House in the 2026 US midterms. The price is what traders will pay for that outcome, which would give one party control of legislation and confirmations.
poly-2026-balance-of-power-d-senate-d-ho.recent: The fortnight's news about this market concerned the betting venues rather than the midterms: 39 states and 145 tribal nations urged the Supreme Court to review prediction markets, and Kalshi's CEO said state-led oversight would push them out. None of it bears on which party wins Congress.

poly-will-indiana-enact-a-data-center-mo.standing: A contract that pays out if Indiana enacts a statewide pause on new data centers before 2027. The state draws large server-farm projects, and local fights over power bills and water make it a test of how far the backlash reaches.
poly-will-indiana-enact-a-data-center-mo.recent: The news about prediction markets in this period concerned who gets to police them: 39 states and 145 tribal nations urged the Supreme Court to take up the question, and Kalshi's CEO said state-led oversight would push the markets out. None of it touched Indiana's data centers or accounts for the swing in this contract.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats win a majority of the US House of Representatives in the midterms. The price is what traders pay for that outcome; the House majority controls spending bills and investigations.

stocks:7974.T.standing: The Kyoto company that makes the Switch consoles and the Mario and Zelda games that sell them. It earns from its own hardware and its own software together, so its profits rise and fall with each console's life cycle.

stocks:UBI.PA.standing: The French publisher behind Assassin's Creed, Far Cry and Rainbow Six, listed in Paris. Its fortunes ride on a few big releases a year, so a delay or a weak launch moves the share more than the wider games market does.

poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve leaves its policy rate unchanged at its December meeting. The price is what traders pay for a hold over a hike or a cut, and it moves with each jobs and inflation report.
poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.recent: Most Federal Reserve officials expect another rate hike by year-end, and an inflation report this week raised the hike odds further, so betting on a hold has grown cheap. Even a jobs count of 29,000 against 90,000 expected only had the Fed seen skipping one meeting, not ending its tightening.

wiki-openai.standing: How many people read the English Wikipedia article on OpenAI each day, the San Francisco lab behind ChatGPT. It jumps when the company ships a model, loses a senior figure or lands in a dispute.
wiki-openai.recent: The FBI charged Abdulrahman Alfozan, an OpenAI engineer, after a recorder was found behind a television in a San Francisco conference room. The same day OpenAI was reported in talks to buy Trail of Bits, which took second in DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge. A week earlier the company released more than 350 mathematical findings in one day.

stocks:BAC.standing: The second-largest US bank by assets, listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Its share price tracks US interest rates, consumer credit and deposit flows across tens of millions of American accounts.
stocks:BAC.recent: The US Treasury imposed more than $1.21bn in penalties on Bank of America for anti-money-laundering and sanctions violations, the third-largest in the department's history, after the bank reported $5 billion in suspicious transactions late. The fine landed the day after the last reading, so it does not explain the slide before it.

stocks:SHEL.standing: One of the world's largest oil and gas companies, headquartered in London, and the biggest trader of liquefied natural gas. Its shares move with crude and gas prices and with the cash it returns to shareholders.
stocks:SHEL.recent: Shell agreed to sell Shell Nigeria Gas, which pipes gas to factories and power users in Nigeria, to Vaaris Energy, and Declassified UK reported that BP and Shell have signed agreements in Venezuela since January. Neither explains the share price: the Nigerian sale was announced after its latest close.

stocks:2222.SR.standing: Saudi Arabia's state oil company, the world's largest crude producer, listed on the Saudi Exchange in Riyadh since 2019. The state keeps almost all of it, so the small float trades on oil prices and the dividend.
stocks:2222.SR.recent: The Houthis claimed a strike on an oil facility near Riyadh, a missile set fire to an Aramco administrative building in Dhahran, and Aramco's CEO said replenishing crude and fuel supplies could take two years after almost 3 billion barrels were lost. Saudi Arabia also cut its oil prices to Asia. None of it accounts for the share's path.

stocks:COIN.standing: The largest US cryptocurrency exchange, listed on Nasdaq. Most of its revenue comes from trading fees and the interest on USDC stablecoin reserves, so its shares rise and fall with crypto prices and trading volume.

stocks:NVDA.standing: The American designer of the graphics processors that train and run most of the world's AI models. Data-centre chips earn most of its revenue, so its share price is read as a gauge of what the industry spends on AI.
stocks:NVDA.recent: SpaceX's big Nvidia buy was reported the week the share peaked. The day after the latest close, an IDC report put Nvidia at 34% of China's data-centre AI accelerator market in the first half of 2026 and Huawei at 28%. Nvidia's China shipments fell 44% to 678,000, as US export controls turned buyers toward China's own chips.

poly-will-luca-niculescu-be-the-next-pri.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Luca Niculescu becomes Romania's next prime minister. Romania's president nominates the premier, who then needs a confidence vote in parliament.

poly-kharg-island-no-longer-under-irania.standing: A bet that Iran will have lost control of Kharg Island, the Gulf terminal that loads most of its crude exports, by the contract's deadline. Taking it would cut off the bulk of Tehran's oil revenue in one move.
poly-kharg-island-no-longer-under-irania.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's reporting mentions Kharg Island. It carried escalation at sea instead: a US jet disabled an Iran-linked tanker, six ships were hit the next day, two Emirati cargo ships sank, and Iran said Washington met only some of seven conditions to reopen Hormuz.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-us-pre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, so it tracks how his standing in the Democratic field is being bet.

stocks:ASML.standing: The Dutch company that builds the lithography machines chipmakers use to print circuits, and the only supplier of the extreme-ultraviolet tools that leading-edge chips need. Export rules decide who may buy them.
stocks:ASML.recent: ASML's results showed chip equipment sales to China up 109%, lifting China's share of its sales from 14% to 23%, even as Washington pushes the Netherlands to tighten export rules. It also forecast fourth-quarter sales above expectations on AI chip demand, so its growth leans on the market US policy wants to close.

poly-will-benjamin-netanyahu-be-the-next.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Benjamin Netanyahu heads the government formed after Israel's next election. The premiership needs a 61-seat Knesset majority, so coalition arithmetic moves it as much as votes do.
poly-will-benjamin-netanyahu-be-the-next.recent: The weeks before Israel's 27 October election brought a CIA report warning that Israel risks civil war, and Ronen Bar, the Shin Bet chief Netanyahu tried to fire, suing him for 3 million shekels over claims that Bar bears responsibility for 7 October. None of it accounts for the swings in what traders pay.

poly-will-mohammed-bin-abdulrahman-al-th.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if a member of Qatar's ruling Al Thani family attends a meeting between US and Iranian officials before 2026 ends. Doha has long served as a go-between for Washington and Tehran.
poly-will-mohammed-bin-abdulrahman-al-th.recent: The one diplomatic thread in the fortnight's news: Iran said Washington's reply to its proposal to reopen Hormuz met only some of its seven conditions, while strikes on ships in the strait went on. None of it names a mediator or accounts for the swing in the price.

stocks:T.standing: One of the three national US mobile networks, alongside Verizon and T-Mobile, and a large fibre broadband provider. A heavy debt load and a long-paid dividend make it a stock held mainly for income.
stocks:T.recent: The sharpest fall came when SpaceX struck a nationwide low-band spectrum deal for Starlink Mobile, putting a satellite operator into the phone business; Verizon fell with it. Days later AT&T agreed to sell AT&T Mexico and its 24.7 million subscribers to Grupo Televisa and Fintech Holdings for $2 billion in cash.

stocks:TLEVISACPO.MX.standing: Mexico's largest broadcaster, listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange, which also runs the izzi cable and broadband network and Sky satellite TV. Its share tracks Mexican household spending on pay TV and connectivity.
stocks:TLEVISACPO.MX.recent: Televisa agreed to pay $2 billion for AT&T's Mexican business and its 24.7 million subscribers, which turns a cable and broadband company into a mobile operator as well. The deal came at the end of the window, and nothing in the input explains the earlier swings in the share.

stocks:TEL.OL.standing: Norway's largest telecoms operator, majority-owned by the Norwegian state, running mobile networks across the Nordics and in Asia. Its dividend makes it a staple of Norwegian pension and income portfolios.
stocks:TEL.OL.recent: Plaintiffs in Oslo sued Telenor, saying it gave Myanmar's junta 1,253 phone numbers and then sold the network, with its call records and location data, to a junta-linked buyer. The suit was filed after the last close on the chart, so it does not explain the slide before it.

poly-another-fed-rate-hike-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve raises its benchmark interest rate again before the end of 2026. Its price moves with US inflation and jobs data, and with what Fed officials say in public.
poly-another-fed-rate-hike-in-2026.recent: The dip followed a Labor Department count of 29,000 new US jobs against 90,000 expected, which left the Fed seen skipping an October rate hike. Bets recovered once most Federal Reserve officials said they expected another hike by year-end, and this week's inflation report pushed them higher again.

poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Houthi forces enter Aden, the southern port that Yemen's internationally recognised government made its interim capital after the Houthis took Sanaa. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome.
poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.recent: The ground war ran the other way from Aden: the Giants Brigades drove the government's advance up the coast toward Bab al-Mandeb, taking Dhubab and cutting the Mocha road. The Houthis reached Aden only by missile, one landing near the airport runway before a flight. None of it fell on the days the price moved.

wiki-china.standing: The daily count of readers of Wikipedia's article on China, the world's second-largest economy and its largest exporter. It shows how often the country's affairs send a general audience to look it up.
wiki-china.recent: The fortnight's China news ran mostly to trade: an EU deal setting a quota on Chinese hybrid car exports, chip exports that jumped 108% in September, ASML's China sales doubling despite US export curbs, and the New Yalu River Bridge to North Korea opening years late. None of it lines up with the early-October peak.

wiki-data-center.standing: A building packed with the servers, storage and network gear that run websites, cloud services and AI models. Its hunger for electricity and cooling now shapes grid planning and power deals.
wiki-data-center.recent: Ukrainian drones knocked out 3 of Yandex's 6 Russian data centers, one of them in Kaluga, then hit the Balakovo data centre of Sberbank, Russia's largest bank. Russia had aimed the same weapon at Kyiv, where strikes on data centres cut internet to 100,000 households, Ukraine says.

stocks:FFH.TO.standing: A Toronto holding company that owns property and casualty insurers and reinsurers around the world and invests their premiums, run by Prem Watsa in a value style. It has built large stakes in Indian companies.
stocks:FFH.TO.recent: Fairfax won 60.72% of IDBI Bank for ₹52,878 crore, India's largest privatisation, which puts the insurer's balance sheet in control of an Indian lender. The award came after the chart's last close, so none of the line reflects it, and nothing in the input explains the earlier moves.

poly-no-hormuz-agreement-by-nov-2.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and the United States fail to reach a deal that reopens the Strait of Hormuz. It is what traders will pay for no agreement, a strait that carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil.
poly-no-hormuz-agreement-by-nov-2.recent: Talks stalled on Oct 11 when Iran said Washington had met only some of its seven conditions, the same day a US jet disabled the Panama-flagged Ocean Molica. Strikes then multiplied: six ships hit in one day, a container ship carrying 2,500 containers sunk by a mine, and two Emirati cargo ships sunk within 24 hours.

poly-will-the-republican-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Republicans hold a majority of the US Senate after the 2026 midterms. Senate control decides which treaties, judges and cabinet nominees get confirmed.

poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-decembe.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Washington and Tehran reach an agreement over the Strait of Hormuz by year's end. About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes through the strait, so the price is a bet on Gulf shipping.
poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-decembe.recent: Six ships were hit in the Strait of Hormuz in one day after a US jet disabled an Iran-linked tanker, a container ship struck a mine and sank, and two Emirati cargo ships went down within 24 hours. US planners drafted strikes with a 21,600-pound bomb, even as a UN official warned fertilizer needs a deal within weeks.

stocks:PLTR.standing: Palantir Technologies, a US software company listed on Nasdaq, sells data-analysis platforms to defence ministries, intelligence agencies and large corporations. Government contracts make up a large share of its revenue.
stocks:PLTR.recent: France chose Chapsvision over another Palantir contract, as European governments question how much of their state data runs on the company's software. Palantir's Louis Mosley answered that Europe is 'missing the boat' on AI. Neither development explains the share's rise.

stocks:GFS.standing: A contract chipmaker that builds other companies' designs, specialising in older, cheaper process nodes used in cars, phones, radios and defence electronics. It is one of the few foundries headquartered in the US.
stocks:GFS.recent: The news about the company itself came after this chart's last close: the Trump administration doubled its equity stake, leaving Washington owning nearly 8% of GlobalFoundries, and will partner with it on a new fab at Malta, New York. That shifts the US from CHIPS Act grants to holding equity, and nothing earlier in the input explains the climb before it.

poly-will-apple-be-the-largest-company-i.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Apple is the world's most valuable listed company by market capitalisation at year's end. It prices a race among a handful of tech giants whose valuations swing on chips, AI spending and earnings.

poly-will-google-have-the-best-ai-model-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Google will hold the top-ranked AI model at the end of October 2026, judged by a public chatbot leaderboard. It prices the race between Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI for the lead.

poly-will-yashar-win-the-most-seats-in-t.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Yashar wins more seats than any other party in Israel's 2026 Knesset election. Coming first in the 120-seat Knesset is not the same as governing, which takes a 61-seat coalition.
poly-will-yashar-win-the-most-seats-in-t.recent: The fortnight's Israeli political news centred on Ronen Bar, the Shin Bet chief Netanyahu tried to fire, suing the prime minister for 3 million shekels over claims that Bar bears responsibility for October 7, thirteen days before Israel's 27 October election. None of it concerns Yashar, and none of it explains what traders are paying.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the former Florida senator, wins the Republican presidential nomination for 2028. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.

stocks:RELIANCE.NS.standing: India's most valuable listed company, a Mumbai conglomerate that runs the Jamnagar refining complex alongside Jio telecoms and India's biggest retail chain. Its size makes it a swing stock for the whole Indian market.
stocks:RELIANCE.NS.recent: Jio Platforms, the group's telecom arm, priced its share sale this week, seeking up to ₹30,213 crore in what is India's largest offering. The listing puts a separate market price on the mobile business that Reliance has so far carried inside the parent's valuation.

stocks:ACN.standing: One of the world's largest consulting and IT-services firms, incorporated in Ireland and listed in New York. Its shares track how much corporations spend on outsourcing, and lately on help adopting AI.
stocks:ACN.recent: The one story about Accenture's own business was a cost cut: staff who had spent up to $1,000 a month on Claude were capped at $29, a firm that sells AI transformation to clients now rationing it for its own workers. It landed at the end of the rise, which began in late September, and does not account for it.

stocks:NESN.SW.standing: The world's largest packaged-food company, based in Vevey, Switzerland, selling Nescafé, Maggi, Purina and infant formula almost everywhere. A heavyweight of the Swiss SMI, its share moves with coffee, cocoa and dairy costs.
stocks:NESN.SW.recent: India's food regulator, FSSAI, found a Nestlé dairy whitener sample unsafe and substandard, in a wider crackdown that also suspended a confectionery firm and recalled cumin; Nestle said the product was safe. The share's trough came the next day. Nothing reported since accounts for the recovery.
